title: Is it possible for a permutation on n symbols to contain exactly n
exact_target: For each pattern size above three, can all permutation patterns occur equally often in one permutation, and can this happen at arbitrarily large orders?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3100034 (AMR-030-0034). CC BY 4.0.

Joshua N. Cooper and Andrew Petrarca, Symmetric and Asymptotically Symmetric Permutations (2008), section 1, exact expected pattern counts; section 2, definitions of nontrivial k-symmetry and Conjecture 1, pp. 1--2.
